---
title: Scholar metadata for a YAML bibliography with explicit tags
format: html
google-scholar: true
bibliography: references-tagged.yaml
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['meta[name="citation_reference"][content*="citation_publication_date=2024;"][content*="citation_volume=2;"][content*="citation_issue=7;"]']
---

The bibliography is a delimited YAML file whose values carry explicit tags, standard (`!!int`) and custom (`!custom`). Pandoc accepts any tag and keeps the value's text, so the Scholar reference tags do too.

This article cites one work [@cited].
